_comment: Deterministic fixture for the plugin safety harness. Seeds the NRL schedule cache with one in-progress, one completed and one scheduled game so live, recent and upcoming each render without a network call. The cache key must match what NrlBaseManager builds from the frozen time and the schedule window (lookback 14, lookahead 7): nrl_schedule_20260626-20260717. Favourite teams are ESPN abbreviations, not numeric ids -- PEN appears in the live and upcoming games and SYD in the recent one, so the favourites-first selection path is exercised rather than skipped.
